data.spamBody: Rejected in the last 24 hours: out of range {oor} · too frequent {rl} · other {other} · reports quarantined {qr} · places quarantined {qp}
data.methodBody: Status is computed from reports in the last 2 hours. Newer reports weigh more, and weight decays by about 63% per hour. Confirmations add weight, disputes reduce it. If the total weight is too small the status returns to No reports yet. Reports quarantined by the system are not counted.
data.privacyBody: No personal data is required. Reporter locations are rounded to about 11 m, never shown publicly, and deleted after 30 days. IP addresses are only stored as hashes with a daily salt.

about.title: About Wenten BBM
about.intro: Wenten (Balinese for "there is") BBM is a community project helping people find petrol stations that still have fuel during Bali's supply disruption. Status is computed from reports by people at the station.
about.how1: People within 300 m of a station report stock per fuel type and queue length.
about.how2: The system combines reports from the last 2 hours. Newer reports and those confirmed by others weigh more.
about.how3: Without new reports the status fades to No reports yet, so stale information does not mislead.
about.safety: Shortages can get worse with panic buying. Fill up only what you need and follow official guidance from Pertamina and local government.
about.disclaimer: Wenten BBM is not an official app of Pertamina, Shell, BP, Vivo, or the government. All statuses are community reports and can be wrong. Always check on site.
about.data: Initial station data from OpenStreetMap (ODbL), verified by volunteers.

seo.h1: Find Bali petrol stations that still have fuel
seo.intro: Wenten BBM shows petrol stations, Pertashop and Pertamini across Bali with live Pertalite, Pertamax and Diesel status from reports by people on site. Open the map to find the nearest station with fuel, its queue and directions. All statuses are community reports, not official Pertamina data.
